functions.name: Cooling spaces
functions.prompt: Alternative operation, or a nearby accessible replacement

functions.name: Clinic or health post
functions.prompt: Backup power for cold storage and fans; staff cover; referral transport

functions.name: Public drinking water
functions.prompt: Tanker supply, stored water, or another source, with quality checks

functions.name: Outreach to people at risk
functions.prompt: An offline contact list, door-to-door visits, volunteers on foot

note: A heatwave can arrive with a power cut and falling water pressure. These prompts help you find what must keep running and what it depends on. They are planning questions, not an emergency protocol, and give no readiness score.

source.label: MCR2030, 2025, p. 26 (Incheon’s functional continuity plan: 61 core functions, alternative workspaces, resources and staff, with scenario-based training)
